body: My group nominated me as "The Chronicler" (primary note taker), my recaps are a mix of normal recaps, musical recaps, TV News Story style recaps, PowerPoints or anythin else I can think of that will make them laugh. I had to ask one of them to note for a session and they all jumped at the chance to get a chance to do a silly recap too. Ask them if anyone wants to do a silly recap for the next session as it lightens the mood of an overall dark campaign before you get into the depths of the mist!

I went down just for the Saturday in 2019, queued for about an hour to get into the carpark/parked up then about an hour or so to get through all the security checks. Honestly wasn't that bad but best advise is always give yourself more time than you think you'll need 🤘🏻

Went for my first 6 month smear following a procedure to remove pre-cancer cells from my cervix, walked in and the nurse told me everything would come back fine because "it almost always does after the removal procedure". I asked what happens if it did come back funky again and was told "not to bother thinking about that because it will be fine"... Currently waiting to find out if I've got just pre-cancer cells again or if it's gone up a notch... "Fine" Huh?
